chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The milk of the cow is a medicine.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the health benefits of cow's milk?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this concise narration attributes the identification of cow's milk as a healing agent to Imam Ali (peace be upon him), reflecting the early Islamic emphasis on practical health wisdom. Within Shia scholarly tradition, this statement is often cited to validate the prophetic and imami understanding of natural remedies, linking physical nourishment with spiritual and bodily well-being.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The cow milk is a medication’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from af-Nawfafiy from af-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ’
Milk products from cows are medicine.”’
